infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your camera to record video tours and capture clips.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your microphone for recording audio.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your location for mapping and emergency dispatch.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your contacts for messaging and connections.
